column2: A bright sunlight shines through the arena. It’s hot, you feel thirsty and tired, the light is hurting your eyes
column3: All Damaging Fire-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. All Water-Type Moves have -1 Damage Dice (except Scald, Hydro Steam and Steam Eruption). No Active Combatants can be affected by the Frostbite Status Condition. (This does not remove it though). Healing Lunar Moves become Minor Heal. Healing Solar Moves become Complete Heal. Damaging Solar Moves don't have a Charge Phase.

column2: A harsh sunlight creates extreme heat through the battlefield, there is lava on the floor and some objects just burst into flames. You might need special equipment to go through this weather.
column3: All damaging Fire-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. All Water-Type Moves fail to be executed. Add 2 dice to any Roll of Chance Dice to Burn a Foe. No one can be affected by the Frostbite Status Condition. Midnight, Acid Rain, Sunny, Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather conditions fail to activate through any means.

column2: A heavy downpour. You are soaking wet. There’s deep puddles and it feels like this will grow into a raging storm any second
column3: All Damaging Water-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. All Damaging Fire-Type Moves have -1 Damage Dice. Healing Solar Moves become Minor Heal. Healing Lunar Moves become Minor Heal. Reduce by 3 the number of successes you need to heal a Burn Status Condition.

column2: A great torrent quickly floods the field, in just a matter of seconds everything is underwater and you struggle to stay afloat trough the crashing waves around.
column3: All Water-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. All Fire-Type Moves fail to be executed. No one can be affected by the Burn Status Condition. Moves that become Complete Heal with Sunny Weather will not restore any HP. Sunny, Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather conditions fail to activate through any means.

column2: A raging wind is blowing sand all over. You can barely open your eyes, it’s had to breath and little sharp rocks pierce your skin.
column3: Deal 1 Damage to all non Rock-Type, Ground-Type or Steel-Type Active Combatants at the end of the Round. Increase 1 Point to the Special Defense of all Rock-Type Pokémon in the field. Healing Lunar Moves become Minor Heal.

column2: Strong wind currents lift and swirl everything in the air, from a tiny pebble to a giant truck. You are either being swept around or falling straight to the floor at a great speed.
column3: All Damaging Flying-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Wind Move Bonus). All Damaging Wind Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Flying-Type Bonus). Electric-Type, Ice-Type and Rock-Type Moves deal neutral Damage to Flying-Type Pokémon. The effects of the Move Tailwind last for 8 Rounds. Pokémon attempting to set other Weather-Types must have higher current Will than the Pokémon that set Strong Wind Weather. In the case of it being a natural effect, other Weather-Types fail to activate by any means.

column2: Heavy ice shards are falling from the sky. It’s cold, it’s snowy and one of those ice pieces may fall right in your head.
column3: Deal 1 Damage to all non Ice-Type Active Combatants at the end of the Round. Increase the Defense of all active Ice-Type Pokémon by 1. Healing Solar Moves become Minor Heal.

column2: Everything is covered in a thick layer of ice and snow, with snowflakes falling all around you. It would be beautiful if it wasn't so cold.
column3: All Damaging Ice-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. Increase the Special Defense of all active Ice-Type Pokémon by 1. Add 1 Chance Dice to all Chance Rolls to inflict Frostbite.

column2: A stinging, toxin filled downpour rains from above. You better seek shelter fast!
column3: Deal 1 Damage to all non Poison-Type and Steel-Type Active Combatants at the end of the Round. All Damaging Poison-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. Healing Solar Moves become Minor Heal. Healing Lunar Moves become Minor Heal.

column2: The skies above are so dark, yet the moon shines down bright. A perfect night for dark and ghost-types to cause a fright.
column3: All Damaging Dark-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Ghost-Type, Darkness Move and Lunar Move Bonuses). All Damaging Ghost-Type Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Dark-Type, Darkness Move and Lunar Move Bonuses). Healing Solar Moves become Minor Heal. Healing Lunar Moves become Complete Heal. All Damaging Lunar Moves gain +2 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Dark and Ghost-Type Bonuses). All Damaging Darkness Moves gain +1 Damage Dice. (Does not stack with Dark and Ghost-Type Bonuses).

column2: A dense, oppressive fog has rolled in. It's hard to make out anything more than a short distance from yourself.
column3: All Active Combatants have -2 Accuracy. (Area Moves, Aura Moves, Sound Moves, Psychic-Type and Ghost-Type Moves ignore the reduced Accuracy). If a Move or Maneuver affected by Dense Fog Critically Fails, Roll Damage and/or effects against a Random Ally or Foe Target instead. (If there is only one available Target resolve the Critical Failure as Normal). Using the Move Defog immediately ends this Weather-Type.
